hard_block_rules: prediction timestamp is missing or is not before event start
prediction is not frozen before outcome
outcome exists without a matching prediction
settled outcome timestamp precedes event start
market probability or closing market probability is outside [0,1]
same sample is used for tuning and evaluation
notes: This gate measures real 2026 out-of-sample weekly betting performance; it does not fabricate preseason holdout results.
Reaching 100 settled holdout bets makes the system eligible for production-trust review but does not automatically activate betting recommendations.
Step 7 cannot rewrite football projections, Step 3B marginal probabilities, Step 3C dependence estimates, or historical calibration artifacts.
